# Stripes ports

| App | Category | Install |
|---|---|---|
| [Alacritty](./alacritty) | terminal | `[general] import = ["~/.config/alacritty/stripes-night.toml"]` |
| [Discord](./discord) | app | Vencord: Themes → Online Themes → paste the raw URL of `stripes-night.theme.css` |
| [Ghostty](./ghostty) | terminal | Copy `themes/*` to `~/.config/ghostty/themes/`, then `theme = stripes-night` |
| [JetBrains IDEs](./jetbrains) | editor | Settings → Plugins → Marketplace → "Stripes" |
| [Kitty](./kitty) | terminal | `include stripes-night.conf` in `kitty.conf` |
| [Neovim](./nvim) | editor | lazy.nvim: see ports/nvim/README.md |
| [Obsidian](./obsidian) | app | Settings → Appearance → Themes → Manage → "Stripes" |
| [Visual Studio Code](./vscode) | editor | Marketplace / Open VSX: search "Stripes" |
| [Windows Terminal](./windows-terminal) | terminal | Copy `stripes.json` to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows Terminal\Fragments\Stripes\` |
| [Zed](./zed) | editor | Zed → Extensions → search "Stripes" |
